# Generated by CodeBreaker (java -> C++, platform pc_opengl). Build:
#   cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja      (or "MinGW Makefiles" / your generator)
#   cmake --build build
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(Game CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS ON)

file(GLOB J2X_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/*.cpp")
add_executable(Game WIN32 ${J2X_SOURCES})   # (WIN32: a windowed program, no console beside it; main() is still the entry)
# (no include directory: the sources include each other with quotes, found beside them; on the include path a class named
# Locale, Error or Regex would stand in for the system's <locale.h> <error.h> <regex.h>, and <string> stops compiling)
if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
  target_compile_options(Game PRIVATE -w -fpermissive)
endif()

find_package(SDL2 CONFIG QUIET)
if(TARGET SDL2::SDL2)
  target_link_libraries(Game PRIVATE SDL2::SDL2)
else()
  target_link_libraries(Game PRIVATE SDL2)
endif()
find_package(OpenGL REQUIRED)
target_link_libraries(Game PRIVATE OpenGL::GL OpenGL::GLU)
target_link_libraries(Game PRIVATE vorbisfile vorbis ogg)   # the game's .ogg sounds and music
if(WIN32)
  target_link_libraries(Game PRIVATE ws2_32)
  # A 16 MB stack for every thread (Windows gives each thread the size the program asks for; MSVC's default is 1 MB, MinGW's 2): the
  # converted methods' frames are larger than the JVM's, and Alpha's world generation recurses deep enough to overflow 2 MB at times
  # and 1 MB always (Linux threads already get 8 MB). Reserved address space only: what a thread never touches costs nothing.
  if(MSVC)
    target_link_options(Game PRIVATE /ENTRY:mainCRTStartup /STACK:16777216)   # (a windowed program whose entry is main, not WinMain)
  else()
    target_link_options(Game PRIVATE -Wl,--stack,16777216)
  endif()
  # The garbage collector (J2xGc.cpp) replaces operator new, and the C++ library must allocate through it: a DLL libstdc++
  # allocates strings with its own (docs/java/RUNTIME_MEMORY.md). Static, it links against the program's.
  if(MINGW)
    target_link_options(Game PRIVATE -static-libstdc++ -static-libgcc)
  endif()
endif()

if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Content")
  add_custom_command(TARGET Game POST_BUILD
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_directory "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Content" "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:Game>/Content")
endif()
